summary: Build Kafka, Spark Streaming, and Flink skills for live pipelines, dashboards, and alerts. Join Trainingcred’s 5-day course.
lede: Real-time analytics uses streaming data to help data, reporting, and platform professionals make low-latency operational decisions. Training covers designing Kafka ingestion and event-driven pipelines, defining processing windows, and handling late-arriving events. Learners also develop live KPI and alert specifications and review data freshness, lineage, access control, and observability.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with data pipelines, reporting, or platform delivery and now need to handle event streams, low-latency decisions, and governed live analytics.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of data concepts, SQL, and basic analytics workflows, plus familiarity with one cloud or on-premises data environment. Prior exposure to Apache Kafka, Spark, or Flink is helpful but not required, and no coding mastery is assumed beyond reading pipeline logic and interpreting configuration choices. A laptop capable of running browser-based labs or local tools is recommended, and participants should be prepared to review sample event streams, topic maps, and dashboard requirements during class.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
